blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The difference between the Half Pad vs G
blocks_element.text: The difference between the Half Pad vs Gel pads is - Half pads are breathable because of the mesh fabric. It has anti-chafing and weighs less than gel pad. Gel Pads conform with the shape of the horse and it has cutting edge technology.

blocks_element.text: Would it work under a western saddle?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · While our half pads are primarily design
blocks_element.text: While our half pads are primarily designed for English saddles, several customers have reported positive experiences using them with their Western saddles.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · What is the difference between the 3D Ai
blocks_element.text: What is the difference between the 3D Air Mesh and Honeycomb half pads?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · While both pads aim to enhance saddle co
blocks_element.text: While both pads aim to enhance saddle comfort and fit by cushioning the horse's back and distributing pressure evenly to minimize the risk of pressure points, they differ in terms of their materials and unique features.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The 3D Air-Mesh Half Pad offers the bene
blocks_element.text: The 3D Air-Mesh Half Pad offers the benefits of 3D Air-Mesh fabric. This innovative design prioritizes breathability and airflow, ensuring your horse's back stays cool and comfortable during rides.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · On the other hand, we have the Air-Honey
blocks_element.text: On the other hand, we have the Air-Honeycomb Half Pad, which incorporates our exclusive Kavallerie trademark technology called Air Cycle Prene™️. This pad utilizes air-honeycomb material. The Air Cycle Prene™️ technology offers a four-layered cushion with hexagonal-shaped holes (honeycomb design). This unique construction promotes superior airflow and ventilation, effectively dissipating heat from your horse's back. The bottom layer of the pad incorporates Coolmax technology, which effectively wicks away moisture, enhancing evaporation and quick drying.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · In summary, both saddle pads prioritize
blocks_element.text: In summary, both saddle pads prioritize comfort and performance, but they vary in materials and features. The 3D Air-Mesh Half Pad focuses on breathability, while the Air-Honeycomb Half Pad showcases our innovative Air Cycle Prene™️ technology, providing excellent airflow and moisture management.

blocks_element.text: The Kavallerie pads seem to be magic; we recently got the majority of our lesson horses saddle fitted and adding these pads perfected the fit for most of the horses, my personal horse included. This particular pad seems virtually identical to the other air-mesh pads, though it may be ever so slightly thicker. The only issue I have with these pads is they are way too long for my 16.5 inch saddle. If your saddle is a 17.5+ inch, they'd probably fit great. I wish they'd make a smaller version.
